title: GASLIGHT, GATEKEEP, V1–V3: EARLY VISUAL CORTEX ALIGNMENT SHIELDS VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS FROM SYCOPHANTIC MANIPULATION
reasoning: The paper investigates the relationship between brain-aligned visual representations and sycophancy (the tendency of models to agree with false user claims) in vision-language models. It does not include an evaluation or benchmark related to religious, faith-based, or moral/ethical systems.
